name: Advected Dye
desc: Vivid magenta, cyan and gold dye injected into a slowly stirring bath and smeared by a two-scale curl-noise flow into marbled ribbons and paisley swirls, rendering as marbled ink on a dark bath, iridescent oil-on-water thin-film, black-indigo suminagashi rings on cream, glowing astro nebula emission, or high-key candy pastels.

swirl.doc: curl vorticity - how tightly the bath stirs into ribbons

bleed.doc: diffusion - low = thin marbled veins, high = soft cloud

hue.doc: base dye hue (magenta anchor; triad rotates with it)

seed.doc: deterministic noise offset + seed blob layout
